description: Detects JavaScript deep-merges or property assignment from user input that can pollute Object.prototype. Use when writing JavaScript or TypeScript code that deep-merges, clones, or extends objects using user-controlled input. Also invoke when using lodash merge/set, Object.assign with dynamic keys, or recursive property copy on untrusted data.
